drugs.name: Ivacaftor
drugs.mechanism: CFTR potentiator that increases chloride channel open probability.
drugs.efficacy: Improves FEV1 and reduces pulmonary exacerbations in CFTR gating mutations.
drugs.disease_evidence: Potentiator monotherapy for CFTR gating mutations.

drugs.name: Lumacaftor
drugs.mechanism: CFTR corrector that improves processing and trafficking of Phe508del CFTR.
drugs.efficacy: Combined with ivacaftor for Phe508del homozygotes.
drugs.disease_evidence: Corrector used with ivacaftor in Phe508del homozygous disease.

drugs.name: Tezacaftor
drugs.mechanism: CFTR corrector that improves Phe508del CFTR processing.
drugs.efficacy: Combined with ivacaftor for Phe508del and residual-function genotypes.
drugs.disease_evidence: Corrector used with ivacaftor and in elexacaftor triple therapy.

drugs.name: Elexacaftor
drugs.mechanism: Next-generation CFTR corrector that increases Phe508del CFTR trafficking.
drugs.disease_evidence: Triple-therapy corrector for Phe508del cystic fibrosis.

drugs.name: Vanzacaftor
drugs.mechanism: Next-generation CFTR corrector used in a once-daily triple regimen.

drugs.name: Deutivacaftor
drugs.mechanism: Deuterated CFTR potentiator used in a once-daily triple regimen.
drugs.efficacy: Component of vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor in phase 3 trials.
drugs.disease_evidence: Potentiator component of the vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor regimen.

drugs.name: Dornase alfa
drugs.mechanism: Recombinant human DNase that cleaves extracellular DNA in airway secretions.
drugs.efficacy: Reduces sputum viscosity and improves lung function in cystic fibrosis.
drugs.disease_evidence: Inhaled mucolytic for cystic fibrosis airway disease.

drugs.name: Tobramycin
drugs.mechanism: Aminoglycoside that inhibits bacterial protein synthesis.
drugs.efficacy: Suppresses Pseudomonas aeruginosa and improves lung function in cystic fibrosis.

drugs.name: Azithromycin
drugs.mechanism: Macrolide that inhibits bacterial protein synthesis and has immunomodulatory effects.
drugs.efficacy: Reduces pulmonary exacerbations in cystic fibrosis with early Pseudomonas infection.
drugs.disease_evidence: Macrolide used for its anti-inflammatory and anti-pseudomonal effects.
